name: skillmeter
description: Live SkillBench telemetry for Codex — lifecycle-hook session analytics, plus sanitized export and review skills.

interface.shortDescription: Live SkillBench telemetry for Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: SkillMeter records privacy-scoped Codex lifecycle telemetry (sessions, prompts, tool use, subagents) and forwards it to the SkillBench analyzer alongside Claude Code and GitHub data. Secrets are redacted fail-closed and paths hashed; harness identifiers (skill/command/MCP/plugin names) are collected raw for internal analysis. Consent is in-context (no OS dialog): new capture requires explicit organization and repository consent recorded in Codex; allowed GitHub organization scope and the Codex pause still apply. Disabling a repository removes its queued, unsent payloads and keeps privacy cursors; the global pause retains queues. Bundled skills also collect, scope-check, and review sanitized exports.
defaultPrompt: Use SkillMeter to check whether this repo matches my allowed GitHub org scope.
Use SkillMeter to review this sanitized export before I upload it.
